comments.body: Hi good question 1 Which platform MS Azure Amazon 2 What do you mean by continue please write in details which functionality interface which code to add

Hi AndrzejRPiotrowski I only provided the scripts to run it automatically on GCP but the code training eval model is platform agnostic It should work on any platform it s only up to you to make it run on the platform you want This repo has been on hold for a little bit you can see there hasn t been any commit in a while I m also not sure all of the API of tensorflow models is still up to date The dataset for this repo is private so you don t have a good way to train the model by yourself While I generally encourage contributions I m not sure the changes you mentioned would be relevant for this repository

Hi good question 1 Which platform MS Azure Amazon 2 What do you mean by continue please write in details which functionality interface which code to add Amazon I was thinking of having this as self diagnostic API For people who want to help build the model So i was hoping that some patients can send x ray as free of charge and help build this model To be specific simple CRUD app with x ray add to model trainning
